'''Lletya''' (Welsh pronunciation: {{Wp|WP:IPA for Welsh|/ˈɬɛt.ə.a/}}, [[rsw:Transcript:Pronunciation_guide#L|Jagex pronunciation]]: ''LLE-to-ah'') is a small village that can be accessed after starting [[Mourning's End Part I]]. [[Eluned]] brings players to Lletya the first time, and gives a [[crystal teleport seed|teleport crystal]] for teleporting back afterwards.

==Transportation==
The only way to teleport to Lletya directly is a charged [[crystal teleport seed|teleport crystal]]. Players can obtain new crystals as a common drop from the [[elves]] in the village. Recharging costs {{Coins|150}} to {{Coins|750}}, depending on how many times it's been charged before.

Beyond the teleport crystal, players can reach Lletya on foot after teleporting nearby. Although they all require substantial walking, several methods of teleporting this way exist, listed here from shortest walk to longest:

* {{Plink|Teleport crystal}} will teleport you directly to Lletya.
** {{Plink|Eternal teleport crystal}}, a variant of the teleport crystal with unlimited charges (after completing [[Song of the Elves]]).
* {{Plink|Iorwerth camp teleport}}, then navigating the forest (after completing [[Regicide]]).
* {{Plink|Spirit tree|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} to Prifddinas, then navigating the forest (after completing [[Song of the Elves]]).
* {{plink|Charter ship|pic=War ship}} to [[Port Tyras]] for {{Coins|3200}}, then navigating the forest (after completing [[Regicide]]).
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{fairycode|BJS}}, then navigating the forest (with 76 [[Agility]] and completion of [[Regicide]]).
* {{Plink|Necklace of passage}} to the [[Outpost]], passing [[Arandar]], and navigating the forest.
* {{Plink|West Ardougne Teleport}}, then traversing the [[Underground Pass]], and finally, navigating the forest.

== History ==
{{LoreSources|Mourning's End Part I|Song of the Elves}}

The eight elven clans formerly lived together in the great city of [[Prifddinas]]. Following the fall of the city at the hands of the [[Iorwerth clan]], however, the other seven clans went in exile in the woodland of [[Tirannwn]]. Lletya was then created, becoming the only elf settlement in [[Gielinor]] until an adventurer [[Song of the Elves|helped restore Prifddinas to its former glory]].

==Locations==
Unlike other villages, there are only two "buildings" in Lletya, connected on the upper level but separated on the ground. A number of locations exist within these structures:

=== Entrance building ===
Upon entering the village, players will be under the arch of the entrance building, containing:

* [[Dalldav]]'s [[Lletya Archery Shop|archery store]], which sells [[arrows]] from [[iron arrow|iron]] to [[rune arrow|rune]], as well as several tiers of [[longbows]] and [[shortbows]].
* Oronwen's [[Lletya Seamstress|seamstress' shop]], which sells [[needle|needles]], [[thread]], [[ball of wool|balls of wool]], and [[dye]] of every colour. Her shop also features a [[spinning wheel]], and behind her shop are three shear-able [[sheep]].

After passing under the arch, players enter the main area, featuring a well, a [[fruit tree patch]], and entrances to the main building.

=== Main building ===
The first floor of the main building features a number of useful stores and locations:

* [[Lletya bank]], the only bank in the area prior to completion of [[Song of the Elves]]. There is a small patch of [[flax]] south of the bank.
* The [[Lletya General Store|Lletya general store]], which stocks the typical general store wares.
* The main hall, which features heavily in the elf storyline. Players needing a new crystal trinket can find one by searching the chest in this room.

The second floor features a [[prayer]] [[altar]], the [[Lletya shrine]], as well as a [[Lletya Food Store|food store]] (selling [[bread]], [[lobster]], [[jug of wine]], [[cheese]], [[cake]]) with a [[range]].

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===
*{{Chatl|Arianwyn}}, the leader of the [[Elven Resistance]].
*{{Chatl|Arvel}}, an elf who's distrustful of adventurers.
*{{Chatl|Dalldav}}, who runs the [[Lletya Archery Shop|archery shop]].
*{{Chatl|Eoin}}, an elf child who plays tag with his sister [[Iona]].
*{{Chatl|Eudav}}, owner of [[Lletya General Store|the general store]].
*{{Chatl|Gethin}}, owner of [[Lletya Food Store|the food store]].
*{{Chatl|Goreu}}, an elf enjoying the beauty of the village.
*{{Chatl|Iona}}, an elf child who plays tag with her brother [[Eoin]].
*{{Chatl|Kelyn}}, an elf instilled with the memories of the former [[Lady Ithell (Fourth Age)|Lady Ithell]].
*{{Chatl|Liliwen}}, a farmer who can [[Disease (Farming)|protect]] a player's [[fruit trees]].
*{{Chatl|Mawrth}}, a mother whose children run about the village.
*{{Chatl|Oronwen}}, the village's seamstress.
*{{Chatl|Tool Leprechaun|text=Tool leprechaun}}, a green-clad fellow who can store gardening supplies and [[Bank note|note]] produce.
*{{Chatl|Ysgawyn}}, a grumpy elf who seeks vengeance for his lost husband (only before completing [[Song of the Elves]]).

=== Monsters or attackable NPCs ===
Within the village:

* [[Elf Archer|Elf archer]] (x2)
* [[Elf Warrior|Elf warrior]] (x4)

Just outside the village:

* [[Dire wolf]] (x2)
* [[Grizzly bear]]
* [[Grizzly bear cub]] (x2)

==Trivia==
* "Lletya" is a Welsh word that translates to the verb "lodge." It was likely intended to use the noun "lodge," in which case, "llety" would be the appropriate translation.
